papers.title_en: FineSplat: Fine Patches, Local Groups, Detailed Splats
papers.authors: Hyebin Kim, Hwasik Jeong, Joonhyuk Park, Gyeongjin Kang, Jungwoo Kim, Younghyun Kim, Eunbyung Park
papers.evidence: 前馈三维高斯泼溅的多视图聚合
papers.tldr: 前馈3D高斯泼溅能即时重建场景并合成新视角，但细粒度几何与外观仍难以恢复，高分辨率token下的全局多视图注意力代价过高。FineSplat以细粒度图像块为基本单元，结合视角分组与3D空间分组的双重局部策略，在保持高效交互的同时重连几何相关token，并利用重建误差提供显式渲染反馈以精修细节。配合紧凑高斯生成方案，它在相同或更少高斯基元预算下显著提升细节质量，取得大幅领先的SOTA结果。
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) promises instant scene reconstruction with high-quality novel-view synthesis. Yet, fine-grained geometry and appearance remain difficult to recover, motivating us to revisit how feed-forward models represent, aggregate, and refine detailed visual information. We introduce FineSplat, a feed-forward 3DGS framework built around fine-grained image patches. Since global multi-view attention becomes prohibitively expensive at such high token resolutions, we develop a dual-grouping strategy that combines two complementary forms of locality: view-wise grouping enables efficient interaction among neighboring views, while 3D spatial grouping reconnects geometrically related tokens that may never have interacted under view-wise grouping by lifting them into the 3D scene space. We further leverage reconstruction error as direct feedback, providing an explicit rendering-based signal to recover fine-grained structures and appearance, thereby overcoming the limitations of one-pass feed-forward prediction. Finally, a compact Gaussian generation scheme preserves the benefits of fine-grained features without unnecessarily increasing the number of primitives. Together, these designs enable FineSplat to recover richer geometry and appearance while remaining efficient and compact, achieving state-of-the-art results by a substantial margin, under the same or smaller Gaussian budgets than existing methods.

papers.title_en: RLSplat: Resource-Linear Budget Control for Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.authors: Injae Kim, Minseok Joo, Jihwan Park, Sehyung Kim, Minseong Bae, Hyunwoo J. Kim
papers.evidence: 资源线性预算控制的前馈三维高斯泼溅重建
papers.tldr: 现有可调预算的前馈3D高斯泼溅方法需先预测稠密高斯再剪枝或选择，推理延迟与峰值内存几乎不随预算下降。RLSplat改为学习高斯分配策略，将预算分配到局部场景区域并精确生成目标数量高斯，再以分层近邻搜索实现资源线性解码。零样本评测中，它在各预算下均优于基线，少4倍高斯仍超最强基线，低预算时最高快4.1倍、峰值内存少9.6倍。该工作使表示规模、延迟和内存随预算线性下降，提升实际部署效率。
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (FF3DGS) reconstructs 3D scenes from images in a single forward pass, making it well-suited to applications that must operate within limited resource budgets. To further improve its practicality, recent budget-controllable FF3DGS methods allow the number of Gaussians to be adjusted at inference, so that the output meets a given storage limit or rendering-latency constraint. However, these methods overlook the cost of inference itself: to produce a representation with the target number of Gaussians, they first predict a dense set of Gaussians and then prune or select from it, requiring nearly constant latency and peak memory regardless of the budget. We therefore propose RLSplat, a resource-linear budget-controllable FF3DGS framework whose representation size, inference latency, and peak memory all decrease linearly as the Gaussian budget is reduced. Instead of pruning or selection, RLSplat learns a Gaussian allocation policy that distributes the budget across local scene regions, so that exactly the requested number of Gaussians is generated. These Gaussians are then refined through resource-linear Gaussian decoding, in which each Gaussian attends only to nearby Gaussians found via an efficient hierarchical neighbor search, so that the decoding cost decreases linearly with fewer Gaussians. In zero-shot evaluation, RLSplat outperforms prior budget-controllable methods at every budget, surpassing the strongest baseline even with 4$\times$ fewer Gaussians, while running up to 4.1$\times$ faster with 9.6$\times$ less peak memory at low budgets.

papers.title_en: CrossFit-GS: Out-of-Fold Pose Estimation for COLMAP-Free 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.authors: Zijian Wu, Jinliang Wang, Mingfeng Jiang, Zidian Lin, Ying Song, Ziqian Lu
papers.evidence: 跨视角互细化位姿的多视图三维高斯优化
papers.tldr: 无位姿3DGS需避开SfM，但序列重建易累积轨迹漂移并让错误地图自我强化。CrossFit-GS采用延迟提交渐进框架，将序列分成交错子集并维护两个互补子图，用冻结对侧子图交叉精化候选位姿，再以棋盘验证和空间覆盖筛选后提交。轨迹精化完成后丢弃中间子图，用固定位姿从零训练全局表示。多基准实验显示其显著降低漂移，并持续提升位姿估计与新视角合成。
papers.abstract_en: Pose-free 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) aims to bypass cumbersome Structure-from-Motion (SfM) by directly reconstructing scenes from unposed image sequences. In this work, we present CrossFit-GS, a deferred-commitment progressive framework that mitigates cumulative trajectory drift and breaks the self-reinforcing loop of distorted-map error propagation. Specifically, we partition the input sequence into interleaved subsets and maintain two complementary submaps. Each candidate pose is cross-refined against a frozen opposite submap that has never been optimized using the target frame, thereby providing an independent geometric reference for pose estimation. Checkerboard validation and spatial coverage safeguards further reject unreliable updates, and only verified poses are committed to their corresponding owner submap. Once the trajectory has been refined, the intermediate submaps are discarded and the final global representation is trained from scratch using the fixed refined poses. Extensive evaluations across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that CrossFit-GS substantially reduces cumulative trajectory drift and consistently improves both camera pose estimation and novel-view synthesis over existing methods.

papers.title_en: GOFusion: Real-Time Gaussian-Occupancy Submap Fusion for Fisher-Informed Autonomous Robot Navigation
papers.authors: Boxin Bu, Simon Boche, Haoming Zhang, Jaehyung Jung, Jiaxin Wei, Hannah Schieber, Daniel Roth, Angela P. Schoellig, Stefan Leutenegger
papers.evidence: 面向机器人导航的三维高斯地图表示、渲染与子图融合
papers.tldr: 自主机器人导航需要兼顾几何规划与高保真外观，但实时大尺度建图受内存与不确定性约束。GOFusion将3D高斯锚定到视觉惯性SLAM生成的局部占据地图，并仅优化活跃子图以限制GPU显存，同时用光栅化集成Fisher近似在线评估基元敏感度。实验在公开数据集和真实无人机飞行中取得更优建图质量，实现实时、高保真、不确定性感知的大规模建图，并完成Fisher启发下的全自主无人机探索与高斯地图细化。
papers.abstract_en: In this letter, we present GOFusion, a real-time visual mapping system for autonomous robot navigation that anchors Gaussian primitives to local occupancy maps, providing both spatial awareness for path planning and high-fidelity appearance that enables information-driven robot navigation. GOFusion builds 3D Gaussian maps from pose estimates and local occupancy maps obtained via visual-inertial SLAM and enables pose corrections to maintain both geometric and visual consistency. Furthermore, it restricts the 3D Gaussian Splatting optimization to active submaps to bound GPU memory usage. Building on the appearance-rich Gaussian map, we introduce a rasterizer-integrated Fisher approximation that quantifies per-primitive sensitivity online, serving as an information-driven heuristic for Gaussian pruning and next-best-view planning. We evaluate GOFusion on public datasets and in real-world drone flights. It not only outperforms several baselines in mapping quality, but also achieves real-time, high-fidelity and uncertainty-aware mapping at scale. Finally, we demonstrate fully autonomous drone exploration for Gaussian map refinement using the proposed Fisher-informed heuristic. Code is available at https://github.com/Bennnoo/GOFusion. We provide a supplementary video demonstration at https://youtu.be/pLQKbxQvb6I.

papers.title_en: MCSplat: Multi-View Photometric and Geometric Consistent Feed-Forward Gaussian Splatting for Driving Scenes
papers.authors: Yifei Wang, Wei Tian, Wenhua Bao, Jia Zhou, Hanshi Wang, Fudong Ge, Jianhua Wu, Shuai Yuan, Zhipeng Zhang, Xingliang Liu, Xianming Zeng, Jianyun Xu, Bingzhao Gao
papers.evidence: 多视图一致的前馈高斯泼溅
papers.tldr: 稀疏多视角驾驶场景的前馈高斯泼溅重建受跨相机光度不一致与深度不连续处法向监督不可靠困扰。MCSplat构建深度引导的多相机对应规范外观空间，并用多尺度Bilateral Grid Transformer恢复相机外观，解耦几何与光度。同时基于Fisher信息估计光度敏感性不确定性，自适应加权表面自监督。实验显示重建质量与泛化提升，跨视角深度和局部法向更一致，重叠视角结构更连贯。
papers.abstract_en: Driving-scene reconstruction via feed-forward Gaussian splatting from sparse multi-view images remains challenging due to two factors. First, cross-camera photometric inconsistency, caused by variations in exposure, ISP, and illumination, can be incorrectly absorbed into Gaussian geometry. Second, unreliable local geometric supervision arises from normal-based constraints near depth discontinuities. To address these issues, we present \textbf{MCSplat}, a multi-view consistent feed-forward Gaussian splatting framework for driving scenes. MCSplat constructs a canonical appearance space from depth-guided multi-camera correspondences to decouple geometry learning from camera-specific appearance. A multi-scale Bilateral Grid Transformer restores raw camera appearance from canonical renderings, enabling photometric supervision without contaminating Gaussian geometry. To improve local geometric reliability, we estimate Fisher-information-based uncertainty from photometric sensitivity and use it to adaptively weight surface-oriented self-supervision. Extensive experiments demonstrate improved reconstruction quality and generalization across driving datasets. Geometry-oriented evaluations further reveal enhanced cross-view depth consistency and local surface-normal agreement, while qualitative results show fewer geometric artifacts and more coherent structures across overlapping views.

papers.title_en: Rethinking Sparse-View 3D Gaussian Splatting: A Few-Shot Learning Perspective on Overfitting Prevention
papers.authors: Lejia Ye, Bin Wu, Jingjing Gao, Yiyang Wu, Xiaohu Zhang
papers.evidence: 从少样本学习视角重构稀疏视角3D高斯优化
papers.tldr: 稀疏视角下3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）易过拟合、几何退化，现有方法多从局部修补数据质量或训练正则，缺乏统一框架。本文把稀疏视角3DGS重构为少样本学习问题，将每个高斯基元视为神经元，统一引入深度学习正则思想。方法上从数据侧用光流引导伪视角合成与相机-场景联合优化增强监督，训练侧用运动感知dropout与早停抑制过拟合。在SIGGRAPH Asia 2025稀疏视角数据集上显著超越优化类与前馈类基线，并获该赛道第一名。
papers.abstract_en: Sparse-view novel view synthesis (NVS) is essential for AR/VR and real-time communication applications, yet remains challenging when reconstructing 3D scenes from limited viewpoints. While 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) excels in dense-view scenarios, it suffers from overfitting and geometry degradation under sparse inputs. Current approaches often tackle these problems from a local perspective, addressing either data quality or training regularization individually, lacking a unified and interpretable framework for systematic improvement.   We introduce a new perspective that reframes sparse-view 3DGS from a few-shot learning viewpoint, treating each Gaussian primitive as a neuron and leveraging deep learning regularization techniques. Under this unified framework, our approach generates more effective supervision from scarce observations through two strategies: (1) data-related supervision enrichment via optical flow-guided pseudo-view synthesis and joint camera-scene optimization; and (2) training-time regularization via motion-aware dropout and early stopping, which suppress overfitting while preserving dynamic-scene stability. Extensive experiments on the SIGGRAPH Asia 2025 volumetric video challenge sparse-view dataset demonstrate significant improvements over state-of-the-art optimization-based and feed-forward baselines. Our system won first place in the sparse-view track of the SIGGRAPH Asia 2025 challenge.

papers.title_en: Drive2Gauss: FeedForward 4D Gaussian Reconstruction from Multimodal Generative Driving Videos
papers.authors: Tong Zhao, Zhiyuan Han, Lin Chen, Bowen Xie, Yunxi Qiao, Bohan Li, Weiqing Xiao, Gen Li, Shu Han, Xuyang Dai, Cheng Bi, Hao Zhao, Chaojian Li
papers.evidence: 支持多视角渲染的前馈4D高斯重建
papers.tldr: 现有方法从生成RGB视频重建显式驾驶场景仍需逐序列优化，难以复用。Drive2Gauss将联合生成的RGB、度量深度和动态流单次前馈转换为动态4D高斯场景，并用高斯查询解码器融合深度初始化、流关联与时空特征。在nuScenes上未来RGB生成FID 6.38、FVD 12.43，重建PSNR 29.91 dB。该框架支持侧向相机位移直接渲染和下游视频修复，提升生成场景的可复用性。
papers.abstract_en: Generating reusable driving environments requires both controllable future observations and an explicit representation that supports rendering from different viewpoints, yet existing methods still recover explicit scenes from generated RGB videos through optimization for each sequence. To overcome these limitations, we present Drive2Gauss, a feedforward framework that converts jointly generated RGB, metric depth, and dynamic flow into dynamic 4D Gaussian scenes. A Multimodal Video Generator predicts the three modalities from reference multiview images and future control signals. Furthermore, we introduce a Gaussian Query Decoder that uses depth to initialize sparse 3D queries and flow to associate the queries across time, and integrates appearance information through spatiotemporal feature aggregation and iterative query refinement. The reconstruction stage operates in a single feedforward pass without optimization for each scene. Extensive results on nuScenes demonstrate that our approach attains an FID of 6.38 and an FVD of 12.43 for future RGB generation, a PSNR of 29.91 dB when reconstructing its generated observations, and supports both direct rendering under lateral camera shifts and downstream video fixing. Code and more visualizations are available at https://zttt04. github.io/Drive2Gauss_page/.

papers.title_en: Counting Contributions, Not Views: Occlusion-Aware Densification for 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.authors: Marcel Rogge, René Schuster, Didier Stricker
papers.evidence: 3D高斯泼溅致密化与渲染核心改进
papers.tldr: 3D高斯泼溅依赖自适应密度控制在稀疏初始化上增密，但现有统计用视锥可见性过滤，无法识别遮挡，被完全遮挡的高斯仍被计入观测，稀释梯度并抑制遮挡区域增密。本文提出遮挡感知过滤，仅用高斯真正贡献的视角统计，并以平均贡献归一化替代原始视角计数，集成到StopThePop框架。在遮挡严重场景中各项图像质量指标均优于基线，LPIPS最多降低6%，高斯数不到视角计数法一半；长调度下数量保持有界，小基准上以更少高斯保持竞争力。
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting grows a dense scene from a sparse initialization through adaptive density control (ADC), driven by per-Gaussian statistics gathered during rendering. These statistics pass a frustum-based visibility filter blind to occlusion: fully occluded Gaussians still count as observed, diluting the averaged gradient signal and suppressing densification precisely where geometry is occluded. We correct this with an occlusion-aware filter that restricts densification statistics to views in which a Gaussian actually contributes, and replace the criterion's raw view-count normalizer with an average-contribution one. Integrated into a StopThePop-based framework, the two together improve every image-quality metric over the occlusion-blind baseline on occlusion-heavy scenes (up to 6% lower LPIPS), at less than half the Gaussians a view-count normalizer requires. Under the longer schedules these large scenes require, the count stays bounded where most criteria diverge, and on smaller benchmarks our method stays competitive at a fraction of the competitors' count.

papers.title_en: HiQGS: Hierarchical Spatiotemporal Querying for Feed-Forward Gaussian Reconstruction
papers.authors: Qiaowei Miao, Qifeng Cheng, Yijing Guo, Yuru Xiao, Ziqian Ni, Sheng Yang
papers.evidence: 多视角前馈高斯重建，跨空间尺度与视角对齐
papers.tldr: 稀疏单目已定位帧的前馈高斯重建需同时处理视角与时间变化，现有方法或将高斯分配绑定到单帧，或用紧凑隐查询聚合而缺乏按目标时刻组织证据。HiQGS提出分层时空编码器，按图像位置、观测时间与相机位姿组织多分辨率几何外观特征，并用时间自适应解码器以目标时间戳查询层次表示、预测高斯场景状态。在静态与动态重建基准上，方法展现出较强渲染质量与几何精度，验证了分层视觉编码和目标时间感知高斯查询的有效性。
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward Gaussian reconstruction from sparse posed monocular frames requires reasoning over observations that vary jointly in viewpoint and time. Existing methods either predict Gaussian primitives from observation-aligned features or aggregate multi-frame information through compact latent queries. However, the former tightly couples Gaussian allocation to individual frames, while the latter does not explicitly structure observed evidence according to its temporal relation to the requested timestamp. Consequently, evidence across spatial scales, viewpoints, and timestamps can be difficult to align and integrate. We present \textbf{HiQGS}, a query-based hierarchical framework for feed-forward Gaussian scene reconstruction from sparse monocular frames. HiQGS introduces a \textbf{Hierarchical Spatiotemporal Encoder} that organizes multi-resolution geometry-appearance visual features according to image location, observation time, and camera pose, thereby preserving complementary appearance and structural cues. Our \textbf{Time-Adaptive Decoder} use target timestamp queries the resulting hierarchical representation to retrieve relevant spatiotemporal evidence and predicts the corresponding Gaussian scene state. Experiments on static and dynamic scene reconstruction benchmarks demonstrate strong rendering quality and geometric accuracy, validating the effectiveness of hierarchical visual encoding and target-time-aware Gaussian querying.

papers.title_en: AirPlayground: Benchmarking Aerial Navigation across Diverse Reconstructed Environments
papers.authors: Rangya Zhang, Yujing Shang, Zhuoyuan Yu, Mingsheng Li, Qingsong Yan, Chao Yan, Yuhang Zhang, Mir Feroskhan
papers.evidence: 基于94个真实感3D高斯城市场景的航拍基准
papers.tldr: 现有航空导航资源缺乏密集飞行演示与标准化闭环评测环境。AirPlayground构建94个室内外及植被3DGS场景，自动采集94K演示与46.5M同步样本，并提供统一训练评测API。七种基线跨四类策略在三类导航设置中评测，ACT语料从5扩至70场景使已见/未见成功率提升。为空中导航离线训练与闭环分析提供共享基准。
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale aerial resources provide a foundation for learning navigation across diverse environments. However, existing resources remain limited in providing (1) densely sampled flight demonstrations for learning different policy formulations and (2) broad environment coverage for standardized closed-loop evaluation. To address these limitations, we introduce AirPlayground, a unified benchmark for training and evaluating aerial navigation policies across diverse environments. We first construct 94 photorealistic 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) environments spanning indoor, urban outdoor, and vegetation settings, with aligned collision geometry. Building on these environments, we develop a scene-adaptive pipeline for automated expert flight collection, yielding 94K demonstrations and 46.5M synchronized observation-state-action samples at 50 Hz. We further provide an extensible API that supports training different policy formulations on this shared corpus and evaluating them under unified protocols in the corresponding environments. We benchmark seven baselines spanning four policy paradigms across three navigation settings in seen and unseen environments, and further examine scaling behavior with ACT. Scaling ACT's training corpus from 5 to 70 scenes raises median success rates on seen and unseen environments from 30.6% and 16.8% to 41.2% and 29.4%, respectively. Through this shared training and evaluation framework, AirPlayground supports analysis of how offline prediction errors relate to closed-loop outcomes. Our analyses highlight the roles of prediction errors, execution protocols, and scene interactions in closed-loop performance.

papers.title_en: PixGR: Pixel-Space Generative Decoding for Fast Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction
papers.authors: Ranran Huang, Wenjing Bian, Weixun Luo, Ye Mao, Krystian Mikolajczyk
papers.evidence: 前馈多视图三维高斯重建与生成式解码
papers.tldr: 稀疏视角下前馈三维重建常依赖回归，难以建模不确定性且易受两阶段VAE误差传播影响。PixGR将轻量像素空间生成建模引入前馈3D高斯重建，用像素空间flow matching对噪声目标视图生成共享高斯表示。它在稀疏观测和视角外推中优于回归方法，保持亚秒推理，并与更重预训练生成模型相当。该工作实现端到端像素监督的三维重建。
papers.abstract_en: We present PixGR, an efficient framework that integrates lightweight pixel-space generative modeling into feed-forward 3D Gaussian reconstruction to model scene uncertainty. Context observations are encoded once into a scene latent representation, which conditions generative decoding from noisy target views to produce a shared 3D Gaussian representation. We formulate this process using pixel-space flow matching, enabling end-to-end optimization of 3D reconstruction with direct pixel-space generative supervision through differentiable rendering. This avoids VAE-based latent compression and error propagation inherent in previous two-stage pipelines. To preserve feed-forward efficiency, PixGR caches the scene representation and performs iterative inference using a lightweight DiT decoder. Experiments demonstrate that PixGR outperforms regression-based approaches in challenging sparse-view settings, particularly with widely spaced observations and view extrapolation. Meanwhile, it maintains sub-second inference and remains competitive with substantially heavier pretrained generative models. Our project page is available at https://ranrhuang.github.io/pixgr/.
